_comment: VALID FIXTURE for UJ-PACK-V0.1 validator tests. Exercises all v0.1 schema additions without triggering any new rule. pack.id != pack-uncle-julios-v1 so the per-pack orphan rule does not apply. fundamentalsTaught is empty across all blocks so the reinforcement rule does not trigger. If your repo's contentPackManifestSchema requires fields not present here, add them — the goal is for this to validate cleanly.
name: Valid Fixture
description: Minimal valid pack used to assert validateContentPackArtifacts returns zero issues against a clean v0.1 manifest.

teachingBlocks.title: Fixture Block One
teachingBlocks.concept: Demonstrate that the validator accepts a clean v0.1 block.
teachingBlocks.explanation: This block is intentionally short. The validator should accept it without triggering any of the six new semantic rules.

commonErrors.description: Treating this fixture as authoring guidance.
commonErrors.remediation: Use the real Uncle Julio's pack for content reference.
commonErrors.realWorldImpact: Fixture content has no operational meaning.
